sentences.quote: Ms. Sandy Ran Xu has been the Chief Executive Officer and Director of the company since 2023. Prior to this, she served as the Chief Financial Officer at JD from 2020 to 2023.
sentences.text: Sandy Ran Xu has served as chief executive officer and executive director of JD.com, Inc. since May 2023, after serving as the company's chief financial officer from June 2020 to May 2023.
She joined JD.com in July 2018 and oversaw group finance, accounting and tax functions, in addition to serving as chief financial officer of JD Retail from July 2018 to May 2020.

Before joining JD.com, she was an audit partner and spent nearly 20 years with PricewaterhouseCoopers Zhong Tian LLP in Beijing and PricewaterhouseCoopers in San Jose, and she was a Certified Public Accountant in both China and the United States.
She holds a bachelor's degree with a double major in information science and economics from Peking University.
She also currently serves as an independent director of Baidu, Inc., as well as a director of Yonghui Superstores Co., Ltd.
